Which of the following statements are true regarding the function $y=\operatorname{tan}⁡x?$ Assume that $n$ is an integer.

I. The domain of the function is all real numbers except $x=\frac{\pi }{2}+n\pi $

II. The function has zeros at $x=\frac{\pi }{2}+n\pi $ for any integer $n$

III. The range of the function is $y\in (-\frac{\pi }{4},\frac{\pi }{4})$
